## Business Mission & Differentiation
Jegatheesh Web Studio focuses exclusively on portfolio websites for photographers and cinematographers. Unlike general web design agencies that use generic templates, Jegatheesh builds bespoke digital spaces where:
- Photography remains the hero: distraction-free chrome, quiet luxury typography, edge-to-edge visuals, and fluid full-screen responsive layouts.
- Fast loading speed is non-negotiable: modern image optimization (WebP/AVIF), asset preloading, and clean code that prevents portfolio lag.
- Conversion-oriented workflows: direct WhatsApp inquiry triggers, one-click email inquiries, and seamless booking widgets that convert visitors into booked shoots.

## Technical Standards
- Semantic HTML5 structure with landmark roles (`header`, `main`, `footer`, `section`, `nav`).
- Complete single-graph Schema.org JSON-LD structured data linking `Organization`, `ProfessionalService`, `Person`, `WebSite`, `WebPage`, `OfferCatalog`, `ItemList`, and `FAQPage`.
- Responsive design tailored for mobile viewports (375px+), tablets (768px+), and high-DPI desktop displays (1440px+).
- Zero-tracking privacy commitment: no invasive cookies, no third-party profiling, and respect for user consent.

## Complete Frequently Asked Questions (Factual On-Page Copy)
1. **Why do I need a website if I already have Instagram?**
   Instagram is great for sharing photos, but your own website gives you a professional space to showcase your work, build trust and attract more clients.
2. **Do I need technical knowledge to manage my website?**
   Not at all. We'll make your website easy to use, so you can focus on photography while we handle the technical side.
3. **Can I choose my own design and style?**
   Absolutely! We'll understand your vision, photography style and expectations before creating a website that reflects your brand.
4. **Will my website work on mobile devices?**
   Yes! Your website will be fully responsive and look beautiful across mobiles, tablets and desktops.
5. **Can I request changes after seeing my website?**
   Of course! You can share feedback, request even the smallest changes and we'll refine everything until you're satisfied.
6. **Will my website help people discover my photography?**
   Yes! We include SEO, AEO and GEO essentials to help improve your website's visibility across search engines and AI-powered search platforms.
